column2: 1. Have you slept badly: found it hard to fall asleep, woken up often or too early?
2. Have you felt sad or had no desire to do things you used to enjoy?
3. Have you felt nervous, restless or full of worries you can't switch off?
4. Have you felt overwhelmed, with too much on your plate (work, studies, home)?
5. Have you felt lonely or avoided being around other people?

The tools (mood log, thought diary, behavioural activation, sleep diary, panic log, social anxiety tools and the personal plan) and your preferences (dark mode, text size) are stored only in your browser using its local storage (localStorage). Nothing is sent to any server. You can delete them at any time from the tools themselves or by clearing the site's data in your browser.
The self-help tools are based on well-known cognitive behavioural therapy techniques. They are a support, not a treatment.
The Spanish and English versions are translations made with the same tool, without review by a translator or a professional.
